requirements.requirement: weekly; ≥3 years and current COT observation
requirements.policy: CFTC public API; WTI futures-only disaggregated report

requirements.requirement: weekly; ≥3 years and current ICE Brent COT observation
requirements.policy: lawful ICE COT route with source identity; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: daily/weekly USO and BNO issuer shares or holdings
requirements.policy: lawful issuer publications only; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: weekly; ≥3 years of commercial and SPR crude stocks
requirements.policy: EIA public API v2; retain revised vintages

requirements.requirement: monthly OECD/global inventory level and days-cover history
requirements.policy: primary EIA/IEA/OECD stock levels and demand denominator; reference but do not duplicate the US inventory series

requirements.requirement: weekly; ≥3 years of refinery throughput and major-product supplied
requirements.policy: EIA primary weekly petroleum series; retain revised vintages and do not infer global demand from US data alone

requirements.requirement: daily; ≥3 years for oil/USD regimes
requirements.policy: reuse one Federal Reserve/FRED semantic series across commodity profiles; no commodity-specific clone

requirements.requirement: monthly; ≥10 years with release vintage
requirements.policy: primary global industrial-production/trade series or licensed PMI with source identity; unavailable otherwise

requirements.requirement: current front-month WTI futures quote
requirements.policy: reuse the swarm pulse quote transport (`@CL.1`); label it futures; no connector clone

requirements.requirement: point-in-time WTI close history with source identity
requirements.policy: reuse lawful shared market history for `@CL.1`; continuous back-adjusted futures

requirements.requirement: point-in-time Brent close history with source identity
requirements.policy: reuse lawful shared market history for `@BZ.1`; unavailable if no licensed feed exists

requirements.requirement: current multi-tenor WTI settlement curve
requirements.policy: lawful CME route with licence/source identity; otherwise manual or unavailable

requirements.requirement: current deliverable WTI cash assessment aligned to Cushing grade, date and unit
requirements.policy: lawful primary/licensed cash assessment; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: cash minus deliverable nearby future, as % of futures, with aligned timestamps
requirements.policy: deterministic derivation from cash-price and futures-curve vintages; no independent vote

requirements.requirement: current aligned Brent minus WTI spread and history
requirements.policy: lawful exchange/market route with both legs and source identity; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: current 3-2-1 or declared refinery crack with aligned legs
requirements.policy: lawful exchange settlements; otherwise manual or unavailable

requirements.requirement: latest quotas, voluntary cuts and observed compliance
requirements.policy: OPEC communiqués plus cited primary production data; manual if no stable lawful route

requirements.requirement: current monthly demand and stock-change bridge
requirements.policy: EIA/IEA/OPEC primary demand and stock releases with estimate identity; reference but do not duplicate supply-security production evidence

requirements.requirement: monthly gross-to-accessible supply bridge
requirements.policy: primary production, domestic absorption, sanctions/restrictions and rerouting evidence; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: current marginal shale/incremental barrel cost range with vintage
requirements.policy: primary producer disclosures and government drilling/productivity data; third-party estimates stay contextual
